services.desc: Effective 1/1/2023 you are no longer required to have a Goodyear business license for your short-term rental. All owners of short-term rentals are required to obtain a STR license in lieu of a business license . If you receive a business license renewal invoice for the next calendar year please email BL@goodyearaz.gov and request that your Business License be inactivated. If you are renting any part of your property for a period of less than 30 days you will need to obtain a Short-Term Rental
